app.tagline: Learn English from your own Notion tables

home.subtitle: Time for a few new words?

goal.title: Daily goal
goal.text: Learn {{goal}} words today to keep your flame alive.

streak.title: Streak
streak.text: Study every day and your flame grows.

notion.title: Connect your Notion
notion.text: Pick a table with words and Lexicove turns it into lessons and games. Words you add here go back to Notion too.

islands.title: Islands of Lexicove
islands.text: Every word category is an island. Learn its words to unlock it.

learn.title: Lessons
learn.text: Spaced repetition and a dozen ways to lock in every word.
features: Flashcards with spaced repetition (FSRS)
Multiple choice in both directions
Spelling, fill in the blank and sentence builder
Listening, dictation and pronunciation with a microphone
Grammar quizzes from your English Rules table

words.title: Your words
words.text: All your words in one place, synced with Notion.
features: Two-way sync with Notion
A ready-made Notion template, or your own table
Add words right in the app
Import and export CSV and Excel
Works offline

games.title: Games
games.text: Quick memory and speed games built from your own words.
features: Match pairs and a 60-second speed round
Word rain: type each word before it lands
Hangman, Wordle and crosswords from your words
Word search and anagrams
True or false blitz

shop.title: Shop
shop.text: Spend the coins you earn in lessons. They can't be bought with money.
features: Animated avatars, frames and profile banners
Themes and card designs
Chat name colours, stickers and titles
Streak freezes, 2x XP and hints

community.title: Community
community.text: Learn with others: chat, friends, duels and leagues.
features: Global chat and rooms by level and topic
Friends and direct messages
Real-time 1-on-1 duels
Weekly leagues from Bronze to Legend
Clans, tournaments and a weekly boss

profile.guestText: Create an account to keep your progress on every device and unlock chat, duels and leagues.
